meta.what: Signed statements: exact UTF-8 text each act signs; signature = Basis Schnorr over those bytes
meta.warning: All keys, codes, ids and tokens here are PUBLIC TEST FIXTURES from an in-memory run. None is valid on any server. Never use the test keys for anything real.

tiers.edge: inputs a client should never produce (informative)
tiers.refused: decline/dispute reasons the real server refuses (400 invalid_field) before any signature is checked; server_outcome shows the refusal; a client must not send them

vectors.name: propose/counter-v2
vectors.note: A counter-offer signs the same "propose" statement over the new version's terms_hash.
